whoTheyAre.summary: The live source identifies Sunda in Indonesia and ties the record to Sunda/Sundanese (sun). Glottolog independently identifies Sundanese and its provincial-identity role in western Java, while locality-specific studies document both ongoing family/community use and pressures on intergenerational transmission.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org supplies an aggregate 'Islam - Sunni' label for this record. It is retained as source context and is not generalized into a statement about every Sundanese person's belief or practice.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record PG022435 reports PEID 22435, display name Sunda, country Indonesia and primary language Sunda (sun).
Glottolog identifies Sundanese with glottocode sund1252 and ISO 639-3 code sun and describes it as a developing language with a de facto provincial-identity role in western Java.
claims.interpretationNote: This is language-level context and does not imply identical language practice across all Sundanese communities.

claims.text: Studies in Cianjur City and Leuwinanggung document continued Sundanese use in family and community domains alongside locality-specific pressures on intergenerational transmission and language vitality.
claims.interpretationNote: These findings come from specific West Java/Depok localities and samples. They are not generalized into one present-day language-use pattern for all Sundanese communities.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record reports 'Islam - Sunni' as the aggregate primary-religion label for PG022435.
claims.interpretationNote: This is a provider classification for one people-group-in-country record, not a statement about every Sundanese person's belief or practice.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record reports GSEC 2, less than 2% evangelical presence and concentrated church-planting activity for PG022435; it also reports Engaged status and existing congregations.
claims.interpretationNote: These are source-native mission-research fields for one people-group-in-country record, not a judgment about individuals.

claims.text: The live structured record reports Bible availability as Available, Jesus Film availability as Available and five total evangelical resources for PG022435.
claims.interpretationNote: Provider availability fields do not establish distribution, comprehension, use or translation completeness.
